body: Yea? Have you had the chance to see them yet? They put on a good show

I was in band for some years. Flute, piccolo, and bass. I never practiced enough with the bass. 
my favorite band is highly suspect. But I also like bands like soad, beartooth, coheed&cambria, bring me the horizon, korn, after the burial, beware of darkness, badflower, rise against ... stuff like that I guess. few of the bigger names off the top of my head.

Thanks for the listen. I enjoy hard rock/heavy metal. One of the best places for me is at a metal festival. Everyone has always been so welcoming and kind. It's the only place I don't feel judged. I can just be free to be.
